news.title: Canton man charged with malice murder in death of 2-year-old
news.summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested and charged with malice murder and child cruelty after a 2-year-old died in Canton. An autopsy is pending.

news.title: Canton man accused of murder following 2-year-old's death
news.summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested on Monday night following the death of an unresponsive 2-year-old child in Canton.

news.title: Man in wheelchair critically injured in Atlanta hit-and-run crash
news.summary: A 69-year-old man is fighting for his life in critical condition after a hit-and-run driver struck his wheelchair on Lee Street SW early Tuesday morning.

news.title: Shooting investigation underway in Midtown Atlanta, police say
Duluth city fountain turned into bubble bath after soap poured into water
news.summary: Duluth police said someone poured soap into the city's Fountain of the Wind on Friday.

news.title: Police in Smyrna trying to identify suspect seen on video pistol-whipping man in road rage incident
news.summary: Police say a man was "pummeled with a handgun" in a fight on June 27.

news.title: 1 injured after parking deck crash leads to Dunwoody shooting
news.summary: A parking deck crash led to a shooting in Dunwoody on Tuesday morning, leaving one man wounded in the foot, according to the Dunwoody Police Department.

news.title: Man found dead on MARTA tracks in DeKalb County
news.summary: A man was found dead on MARTA tracks in DeKalb County Monday night, prompting a temporary suspension of rail service while authorities investigated.

news.title: 26-year-old man killed late Monday in downtown Atlanta area
news.summary: Atlanta police have detained a person of interest after a 26-year-old man was fatally shot late Monday at an apartment complex on Joseph E. Boone Boulevard.

news.title: Have you seen him? Bartow sheriff searching for wanted man
news.summary: Bartow County sheriff's deputies are searching for Andrew Lane Whitfield, who is wanted on several criminal charges.

news.title: How federal agents uncovered a massive fentanyl stash in Henry County
news.summary: Federal agents arrested a 39-year-old man after locating over two pounds of hidden fentanyl and a handgun at and near his Stockbridge home.

news.title: Man dead after shooting in Snellville; suspect in custody
news.summary: The victim died at the scene, police said.
